title: The fibre-dimension function of a proper map of spaces is upper semi-continuous
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y a proper morphism of algebraic spaces over S, the fibre-dimension function n_{X/Y} (from the base-change-dimension-fibres lemma) is upper semi-continuous. The retained proof is written out in full: for each d set Z_d = {x in |X| : the fibre of f at x has dimension > d}; the bounded-dimension-fibres lemma (Morphisms of Spaces, openness-bounded-dimension-fibres) makes Z_d closed in |X|; properness makes f(Z_d) closed in |Y|; and y lies in f(Z_d) exactly when n_{X/Y}(y) > d, which is the upper semi-continuity criterion. Retained author proof at lines 7235-7244.
